title: Model recommendation: subtract TTS + Whisper VRAM before choosing a profile
body:
Part of #625 (non-NVIDIA support). Builds on #1076.

`recommendModelProfile` (`node-bot/model-management.js`) picks fast/default/quality from total VRAM alone. Its own comments admit Whisper and TTS VRAM are ignored, and the tiers just hope to leave "headroom for TTS and Whisper". An 8 GB card running Fish (~5 GB) has room for the 1.5B model at most, not the 4B one.

What I want:
- A small VRAM table for the voice stack: Fish, Qwen3-TTS, and Whisper by model size (Kokoro runs on CPU, so 0).
- Subtract what the active TTS provider and Whisper model hold before choosing the profile, and say so in the reason text.
- Tiers based on the VRAM left for the LLM. At 8 GB with Fish on, it picks "fast".
- Doctor and `/models/status` should show the same recommendation.
interface: `recommendModelProfile({ vramMb, ramMb, voiceMb })`: `voiceMb` is the VRAM TTS and Whisper hold; the reason says e.g. `~5.3GB of it held by TTS and Whisper, leaving ~2.7GB for the LLM`. `createModelManagement` takes `ttsProvider` and `whisperModel` (a model file path) to work that out.
why: Arithmetic in model-management.js (subtract TTS and Whisper VRAM before picking a tier). The real fix also touched server.js; the hidden test is pure.
